An instantiated combo appears under a synthetic hash-suffixed event (KXMVESPORTSMULTIGAMEEXTENDED-S20264E1F9411A8E) whose legs are named in custom_strike rather than under any single game's event. What it does report per game is which of that game's events Kalshi lists as combo-eligible legs.
